name: assistant
description: Drive the in-app AI assistant panel (for testing the assistant itself). action: open | close | send (text) | transcript | new | provider (index 0 Claude login, 1 Codex login, 2 Claude API key, 3 OpenAI API key).

action.description: open | close | send | transcript | new | provider

name: batch
description: Run several tool calls in order in one round trip. Stops at the first error. calls: [{tool, args}].

name: cae_state
description: CAE solver status and results. Start cae_thermal or cae_modal with run_command(commit=false), configure body/faces/material and parameters, then command_set with 'Run analysis':true. action: status | stop. Case files remain in resultFolder. Fluids currently use the separate cae_pipe_flow reduced-order command.

name: command_cancel
description: Cancel the active command (or the sketch if one is open and no command is active).

name: command_commit
description: Press OK on the active command.

name: command_set
description: Change parameters and/or selection slots of the command currently open in the panel (live preview updates).

name: delete_objects
description: Delete objects by name.

name: describe_command
description: What a command needs before you run it: its selection slots (what each accepts, whether it is optional or takes several) and its parameters (type, default, unit, range, options). Nothing is started or changed. Then pass slots and params to run_command using these labels.

name: document_close
description: Close a document tab (discards unsaved changes).

name: document_list
description: The open documents (tabs).

name: document_new
description: Open a new empty document in its own tab.

name: document_switch
description: Bring a document tab to the front by index (0-based) or title.

name: drawing_export
description: Produce an engineering drawing of the model and save it as .svg, .pdf or .dxf (chosen by the extension). Hidden-line-removed orthographic views in third-angle layout (front, top, right, iso by default; first_angle:true to swap) at an automatic standard scale, with overall dimensions, hole callouts (Ø, count, THRU or depth), centerlines and locating dimensions, optional section and detail views, hand-placed annotations (dimension, diameter, radius, note, balloon, datum, gdt frames, surface finish), a bill of materials when several bodies are drawn, general tolerance and notes, and a title block. Drawn from the named objects, or every visible solid/surface/Freeform when none are named. View coordinates in sections/details/annotations are the view's drawing coordinates in mm: front x = model X, y = model Z; top x = X, y = Y; right x = Y, y = Z.

objects.description: Object names to draw (default: all visible bodies).

views.description: front | back | top | bottom | left | right | iso (default front, top, right, iso).

sheet.description: A4 | A3 (default) | A2 | A1 | A0 | Letter | Tabloid | ANSI-C | ANSI-D.

units.description: mm (default) or in: dimension text units.

material.description: Material note (default: the first object's material).

hole_callouts.description: Ø callouts for holes and bosses (default true).

bom.description: Bill of materials table (default: when more than one part).

sections.description: Section views: [{parent:'front', direction:'vertical'|'horizontal', offset: position in the parent view's mm coordinates (default the middle)}]. Lettered A-A, B-B, hatched, with the cutting line on the parent.

details.description: Detail views: [{parent:'front', center:[x,y], radius, ratio (magnification relative to the sheet scale, default 3)}].

annotations.description: Hand-placed items: {type: dimension|diameter|radius|note|balloon|datum|gdt|finish, view, from:[x,y], to:[x,y], at:[x,y], center:[x,y], radius, angle, offset, orientation: horizontal|vertical|aligned, text, tolerance (e.g. '+0.1/-0.05'), number (balloon), symbol (gdt: flatness, straightness, circularity, cylindricity, perpendicularity, parallelism, angularity, position, concentricity, symmetry, runout, total_runout, profile_line, profile_surface), datums:'A|B'}.

name: edit_feature
description: Edit an earlier feature (the model rolls back to before it and its command reopens with the same picks and numbers; change values with command_set, then command_commit rebuilds the later steps). action: list (steps that can be edited) | open (step = history step id; omitted = the step that made the selected object).

step.description: History step id from list or history_tree.

name: file
description: Document I/O. action: new | open | save | save_as | import_step | import_file (by extension: STEP, IGES, BREP, DXF, STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF) | export_step | export_iges | export_brep | export_glb | export_dxf | export_stl (also .3mf/.obj/.ply by extension). 'path' required except for new/save.

name: form_analyze
description: Surface quality of a Form: cage statistics (quads, triangles, n-gons, poles with their positions, edge lengths, stretched quads), curvature of the smooth surface (mean, tightest radius and where), and optionally the deviation to a reference object (scan, body, form): within-tolerance percentage, RMS, bias, largest gaps. display:true also colors the form by that deviation in the viewport.

reference.description: Object to compare the smooth surface with.

name: form_find
description: Find cage components by geometry so you do not have to read the whole cage. kind: vertices | faces | edges (default faces). Filters (all optional, combined with AND): box [[x0,y0,z0],[x1,y1,z1]] (a vertex, or a face/edge centre, inside), near [x,y,z] + radius, facing [dx,dy,dz] + angle (faces whose normal is within angle degrees, default 30), open:true (edges used by one face only), all:true. Returns 0-based indices ready for form_op / form_select, with centres (and normals for faces).

facing.description: Faces whose outward normal points this way [dx,dy,dz].

name: form_info
description: Read a Form object (subdivision cage): vertices, faces (vertex index lists, 0-based, CCW from outside), creased edges, smoothing level. Indices here are 0-based and are what form_op expects.

summary.description: Counts and bounding box only (no vertex or face lists).

only.description: Vertex indices: return only the positions of these vertices.

name: form_op
description: Edit a Form cage (undoable). op: chamfer (edges or faces, amount: replaces each inner edge with a strip of faces) | slide (edges, amount -1..1: slide an edge loop along its rails) | crease_vertices (vertices, value: sharp corner points) | set_symmetry (symmetry x|y|z|radial:N|off, enforce:true makes the cage exactly symmetric from the + side, keep_positive:false for the - side) | move | rotate | scale | bridge | fill_holes | merge_faces | merge_edges | unweld_edges | pull | collapse_edges | split_face | smooth | flatten | set_vertices | extrude_faces | extrude_edges | inset | bevel | insert_loop | subdivide | delete_faces | weld | flip | crease | mirror | add_face | thicken | level. A form with a persistent symmetry (set_symmetry) repeats extrude/inset/bevel/delete/crease/flatten/smooth/weld/collapse/unweld/pull/insert_loop/merge_faces on the mirror images of whatever you select; pass symmetry:off to bypass it for one call. pull: vertices (or all) move onto the smooth limit surface (strength 0..1). merge_edges: edges:[[a,b]..] removes inner edges, joining the faces either side. unweld_edges: edges (or faces) split the cage along them so each side gets its own points. bridge: faces:[a,b] removes two separate equal-corner cap faces and joins their loops (for integrated handles), or edges:[[a,b],...] selects two separate boundary chains. move/rotate/scale act on the vertices of whatever you select and accept soft_radius (+ falloff smooth|linear|sharp) and symmetry (x | y | z mirror, or radial:N around Z; mirrored points follow). rotate: axis X|Y|Z, angle (degrees), optional pivot [x,y,z] (default the selection centre). scale: factor, or scale [sx,sy,sz], optional pivot. inset: faces, amount, optional depth and individual:true. bevel: edges or faces, amount (support loops that tighten the edge). insert_loop: edge [a,b], optional count and position (0..1 from a). Components are 0-based indices from form_info: vertices:[i..], faces:[i..], edges:[[a,b]..]. move: delta [dx,dy,dz] applied to the vertices of whatever you select. set_vertices: positions {"3":[x,y,z]}. extrude_faces/edges: distance. insert_loop: edge [a,b]. crease: value (0 clears). mirror: plane XY|XZ|YZ (welds the seam). add_face: vertices [ids] and/or points [[x,y,z]] (new corners) - ids first. level: value 1-4.

all.description: move/rotate/scale/smooth/flatten: act on every vertex when nothing is selected.

individual.description: inset each face on its own.

position.description: insert_loop: 0..1 from the first vertex of the edge.

name: form_select
description: While Edit Freeform is open (run_command edit_form with commit=false), select cage components so the manipulator and highlights show. mode: vertices|edges|faces. Indices are 0-based as in form_info.

all.description: Select every component of that kind.

op.description: grow | shrink | invert | all | angle (flood faces from the selection) | boundary | creased: selection tools applied after any indices given.

angle.description: With op angle: dihedral limit in degrees (default 30).

name: form_to_nurbs
description: Convert a Form into exact NURBS geometry (a solid if the cage is closed, otherwise a surface). The result can be used with booleans, fillets, STEP export, etc.

detail.description: exact (default) | fewer: one fitted patch per irregular face instead of four, for lighter models.

name: get_control_points
description: Read the NURBS control net of a curve or single-patch surface (rows x cols, row-major).

name: get_log
description: Recent status/error messages shown in the status bar (newest last).

name: get_state
description: Full snapshot: objects (with bounding boxes), selection, active command and its parameters/slots, sketch, camera, display flags, status line.

fields.description: Only these top-level keys, e.g. ["objects","selection","status"]. Default: all.

objects.description: full (default) | names (one 'name [kind]' string per object, far smaller) | none.

limit.description: Most objects to list; objectsTotal gives the real count.

name: history
description: Undo or redo.

name: history_goto
description: Jump to a history step by id (see history_tree). Use this to switch between branches.

name: history_group
description: Fold a run of steps into ONE undo step. Call with action:begin, make changes, then action:end with a label. Groups nest.

name: history_tree
description: The full history tree: every step with its parent, label, time, checkpoint name and which one is current. Branches exist when an edit was made after rolling back.

name: history_view
description: Inspect or resize the design history panel. Collapsed mode shows a compact, interactive trail of the active branch.

expanded.description: Show the full branch graph, or the compact trail when false.

name: list_commands
description: List the command names run_command accepts, optionally only those containing 'query' (case-insensitive). Without a query returns the count and the first 60.

query.description: Text the name contains, e.g. 'fillet' or 'cam'.

name: list_ribbon
description: List every ribbon tab, group and button (label, enabled, checked). Use with ribbon_click.

name: marking_menu
description: The right-click marking menu. action: settings (open the Settings window) | menu (the 6 o'clock plain menu) | list (the eight entries for what is selected right now, clockwise from the top), open (show it at x,y in the viewport), run (index 0-7: do that entry).

name: material_apply
description: Give an object a library material (color, finish and density come with it), or just set its finish/color. 'material' is an id or name from material_list; omit it to only change metal/gloss/color. Returns the object's mass when it is a solid.

pattern.description: Automatic | Plain | Wood | Brushed | Cast | CarbonWeave. Appearance only.

patternAngle.description: Pattern angle about world Z, degrees.

name: material_list
description: List library materials with engineering data (density g/cm3, modulus GPa, yield/tensile MPa, conductivity, expansion, max temp, ratings). Short by default (id, name, category, density); pass brief:false for the full engineering data. Optional 'category' or 'search' filter.

search.description: Text to match in name, family or uses.

brief.description: Default true: id, name, category and density only.

name: materials_panel
description: Open (open=true) or close the Materials workspace tab. Optionally select a library material in it.

material.description: Material id to highlight in the list.

name: mesh_export
description: Export meshes/bodies to STL, 3MF, OBJ or PLY (chosen by the extension). Exports the selection, or everything when nothing is selected.

name: mesh_import
description: Import a mesh file (STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF) as one or more mesh objects. Without options it imports as-is (mm, Z-up, no repair). Colours and parts in the file are kept.

units.description: auto (default: the 3MF's own unit, else mm) | mm | cm | m | inch.

up_axis.description: z (default, keep) | y (rotate Y-up to Z-up) | x (rotate X-up to Z-up).

weld_tolerance.description: Merge vertices closer than this many mm (default 0: identical corners only).

auto_repair.description: Merge, clean, fix normals and fill small holes (default false).

split.description: auto (default: 3MF objects become separate bodies) | none | groups (file parts: 3MF object, OBJ object/group, STL solid) | components (connected pieces).

name: mesh_region
description: Select triangles on a mesh (the region later used by mesh_fit_surface, extract and delete). action: smart (flood a smooth patch from the triangle nearest 'at', with 'angle'), brush (triangles within 'radius' of 'at'), box (triangles whose centroid is inside 'min'/'max'), grow, shrink, invert, all, clear, extract (new mesh), delete. mode: replace (default) | add | subtract.

action.description: smart | brush | box | grow | shrink | invert | all | clear | extract | delete

at.description: [x,y,z] point on or near the surface.

angle.description: Edge angle in degrees for organic surfaces (default 20).

tolerance.description: Surface tolerance in mm for the shape fit (default 0.3% of the mesh size).

name: object_info
description: Detailed information about one object: volume, area, size, center, validity, sketch plane.

name: object_update
description: Rename, recolor or show/hide an object.

name: origin
description: Show or hide the origin helpers (they also appear in the browser): planes, axes, origin point.

name: pointer
description: Send mouse events to the 3D viewport at world positions: events [{type:'move'|'down'|'up'|'drag', x,y,z, x2,y2,z2 (drag end)}]. Returns the active command's grab handle (origin, tip, value) and the camera.

name: render_control
description: Inspect or control the current document's render. action: status | stop | save | close. Start with run_command(name=render, commit=false), then command_set parameters including 'Start render'. Status reports sample progress, completion and errors; save writes completed samples to PNG.

path.description: Optional full PNG path for save.

name: ribbon_click
description: Click a ribbon button by its label (exactly what a user would click). Optionally pass 'tab' to disambiguate (e.g. 'Extrude' exists on Solid and Surface). Commands open their panel; use command_set / command_commit next.

name: run_command
description: Run a modeling command end-to-end: start it, fill selection slots and parameters, then (by default) commit. Find names with list_commands(query). 'slots' maps a slot label to an object name, {object,face|edge} or an array of those; 'params' maps parameter labels to values. For curve_control/curve_through pass 'points' as [[x,y,z],...]. Use get_state afterwards, or call with commit=false to preview first.

name: screenshot
description: Capture the app window as a PNG. Whole window by default (ribbon, panels, viewport); viewport:true captures only the 3D view, which is what you usually want to judge a model and costs far fewer tokens. max_width shrinks the picture (e.g. 900).

max_width.description: Scale down to at most this many pixels wide.

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for a fresh frame before capturing (default 250).

name: script_dialog
description: Show a dialog and wait for the user: fields [{key, label, type: number|text|check|choice, value, min, max, step, options, unit}]. Returns {ok:true, values:{key: value}} or {ok:false} when cancelled. Meant for scripts that need input.

name: select
description: Set the document selection (outside of commands). Items are object names, or {object, face} / {object, edge} (1-based).

name: set_control_points
description: Replace the control points of a curve/surface (same count and order as get_control_points). Undoable.

name: sketch_add
description: Add geometry to the open sketch using the same tools as the mouse (so auto-constraints apply: coincident joints, horizontal/vertical, tangents...). Coordinates are 2D [u,v] on the sketch plane. Entity types: line {points:[[u,v],[u,v]]}; polyline {points, closed?}; rect {corner1, corner2} | {center, corner} | {points:[p1,p2,p3]} (3-point); circle {center, radius} | {points:[p1,p2]} (2-point) | {points:[p1,p2,p3]} (3-point); arc {points:[start,mid,end]} | {center, start, end}; ellipse {center, major:[u,v] (end of one axis), minor (other radius)}; line also takes midpoint:true ([middle, end]); polygon {center, radius, sides, circumscribed?}; slot {center1, center2, width}; spline {points, closed?, control?}; point {at:[u,v]}. Add "construction":true for reference geometry.

name: sketch_begin
description: Start a sketch. plane: 'XY', 'XZ' or 'YZ' (optional offset along the normal), a planar face {object, face}, or an origin plane name. To edit an existing sketch pass edit:'Sketch 1' (its constraints and dimensions are preserved).

plane.description: 'XY' | 'XZ' | 'YZ' | the name of a construction plane | {object, face}

edit.description: Name of an existing sketch object to edit.

look_normal.description: Align the camera when starting; false preserves the current 3D view.

name: sketch_constrain
description: Add a geometric constraint. type: horizontal | vertical | coincident | parallel | perpendicular | tangent | equal | midpoint | concentric | collinear | symmetric | fix. refs: ids like 'e3' (entity) and 'p5' (point) - e.g. horizontal ['e3'] or ['p1','p2']; coincident ['p1','p2'] or ['p1','e4'] (point on curve); parallel ['e1','e2']; midpoint ['p3','e1']; symmetric ['p1','p2','e5']; fix ['p1'] or ['e2'].

name: sketch_delete
description: Delete sketch entities ('e3') or constraints (by id).

name: sketch_dimension
description: Add a driving dimension; the sketch is solved to match. type: length (line) | distance (two points) | hdistance | vdistance | radius | diameter | angle (two lines, degrees) | point_line. refs like constrain. value in mm (or degrees).

name: sketch_finish
description: Finish the open sketch (keep=true creates/updates the Sketch object, false discards it). Returns a short status; verbose:true returns the whole document state.

name: sketch_input
description: Drive the open sketch like the mouse and keyboard. Optionally pick a tool (line, line_mid, rect, rect_center, rect_3pt, ellipse, circle, circle_2pt, circle_3pt, polygon, slot, spline, spline_control, edit_spline, select, constrain:<type>), then send events: {type:'move'|'down'|'up'|'click'|'dclick'|'key', u, v (sketch plane coords), shift, alt} or {type:'key', key:'Char:5'|'Tab'|'Enter'|'Escape'|'Back'|'Delete'|'RightClick'|'Char:L'|'Char:C'|'Char:X'}. Returns the on-screen read-out labels, the status line and the sketch state.

name: sketch_mirror
description: Mirror sketch entities across a line entity. live=true keeps the copy tied to the original with symmetry constraints.

axis.description: Line entity id to mirror across, like 'e7'.

name: sketch_pattern
description: Repeat sketch entities. type linear: offset [du,dv] between copies. type circular: center [u,v] and optionally angle (degrees between copies; default = evenly around 360). count = total copies including the original.

name: sketch_plane
description: Control the unified sketch work plane. Actions: select (1-based index), new, xy, xz, yz, origin ([x,y,z] mm), rotate ([x,y,z] world degrees), size (display multiplier), snapping (other_curves and project), normal, gizmo, edit. Existing curves retain their original drawing planes.

name: sketch_project
description: Bring geometry from outside into the open sketch (locked in place). mode edge: project one edge of an object (object name or id, edge index) | body: project all edges of an object | section: the curves where an object crosses the sketch plane. Good for lofts: copy or slice an existing body to get matching profiles.

name: sketch_set_dimension
description: Change the value of an existing dimension (by constraint id from sketch_state) - the sketch updates parametrically.

name: sketch_state
description: The open sketch's model: points, entities (ids), constraints and dimensions, degrees of freedom and solver status. Refs use 'p<id>' for points and 'e<id>' for entities.

name: sketch_trim
description: Trim a line, arc or circle: removes the part of curve 'e3' nearest to the point at:[u,v], cutting back to the crossing curves on each side (a curve nothing crosses is deleted).

at.description: Point [u,v] on the part to remove.

name: solid_check
description: Cheap verification of a body, or measurement between two things. With only 'object': validity, volume, area, bounding box, size, centre of mass, counts of faces/edges/shells/solids and open (free) edges. With 'a' and 'b' (each an object name or {object, face|edge}): the minimum distance between them and the two closest points; if they overlap, 'overlap' is true and the volume of the overlap is reported when both are solids.

object.description: Object to check (also used as 'a' when only 'b' is given).

name: solid_find
description: Find faces or edges of a solid/surface by geometry instead of by index. kind: faces (default) | edges. Filters (all optional, AND): type (Plane, Cylinder, Cone, Sphere, Torus, ... for faces; Line, Circle, ... for edges; prefix match), facing [dx,dy,dz] + angle (faces whose normal is within angle degrees, default 5), direction [dx,dy,dz] + angle (straight edges parallel to it, default 5), radius (+ radius_tol, default 0.001), box [[x0,y0,z0],[x1,y1,z1]] (centre inside), near [x,y,z] + distance (centre within distance), of_face N (edges bounding face N, 1-based), min_size / max_size (area for faces, length for edges). sort: size | -size | x | -x | y | -y | z | -z (centre coordinate), limit (default 40). select:true selects the hits (and they are listed 1-based, ready for run_command slots {object, face|edge}). summary:true returns only counts per type. Returns total, shown and the hits with type, centre, area/length, normal/direction, radius.

radius.description: Radius of cylindrical/spherical faces or circular edges.

box.description: Centre must lie inside this box.

name: study_new
description: Start a static study on a solid body (the selected one, or the named one). Then add fixtures and loads with run_command sim_fixed / sim_roller / sim_force / sim_pressure / sim_torque / sim_gravity and call study_run.

element_size.description: Target element size in mm (0 = automatic).

name: study_run
description: Mesh and solve the active study (blocks until done) and return the key results. Optionally switch the displayed result: von Mises, displacement, safety.

name: study_state
description: The active static study: fixtures, loads, mesh size and (if solved) the key results and notes.

name: view
description: Control the camera and display. preset: front|back|left|right|top|bottom|iso. Or yaw/pitch in degrees. fit=true zooms to extents.

xray.description: Enable or disable translucent X-ray, independently of display style.

look_at.description: Look straight at the selected plane, face or sketch (or the open sketch).

layout.description: single | dual (model + top) | quad (front, right, top + model)

link.description: Link pan/zoom between the views of a multi-view layout.

name: wait_idle
description: Wait until the view has stopped animating (after view, a tool that turns the camera, Tab in 3D sketch...) so the next pointer event or screenshot sees the final camera. Optional extra ms to wait afterwards.

name: workflow_state
description: Saved CAE setups, named selections, CAM setup and live path playback. Optional staticStudy selects a static study by name.

name: workspace
description: Switch workspace: design | scan | cae (or simulate) | assemble | render | ar | make | script | all. CAE includes Static, Thermal, Dynamics, Motion (kinematics and rigid-body motion of an assembly) and Fluids. make opens Manufacture/CAM.

id.description: Workspace id; cae opens CAE, make opens CAM.
